facts.fact: Burundi's Permanent Secretary for Communication, Information Technologies and Media spoke at the EAC EARDIP national consultations of August 2025 on the One Network Area roaming framework.
Somalia, a full EAC member since 4 March 2024, took part in the August 2025 EARDIP consultations, where its National Communications Authority called joining the One Network Area urgent.
